summary: Tested the new Pacas module end-to-end on tenant outletsusaec. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed covering CRUD, sales (with purchase + wallet integration), stats, and auth. Frontend: Pacas appears in sidebar (Package icon), /admin/pacas page loads with 4 KPI cards (Pacas Registradas, Ventas Semana, Ingresos Semana, Ganancias Semana), elegant orange header with logo + Estadisticas + Nueva Paca buttons, Nueva Paca dialog has name/description/sale_price/commission combo ($50/$55/$60/Otro), Vender dialog finds client J2934 (Juan Perez) by code, 'Crear Cliente Nuevo' option is present in code for when client not found, /admin/pacas/stats renders KPIs + trend/bar/pie charts, and /admin/stats shows the integrated 'Ganancias Pacas: $60.00' card.

issues: Minor: KPI labels show '(Semana)' in parentheses rather than 'Ventas Semana'. Requirements said 'Ventas Semana' – harmless cosmetic difference.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >11500 lines – should be split into routers (pacas, inventory, wallet, etc.) for maintainability. Not blocking but repeatedly flagged.
Route ordering is correct: /pacas/sales, /pacas/sales/list and /pacas/stats are declared BEFORE /pacas/{paca_id}, so no collision.
POST /api/pacas/sales decrements wallet.available even when it goes negative – acceptable only if negative balances represent credit/debt; otherwise should block or validate.
PacaUpdate.model_dump() filters only values != None; cannot clear 'description' back to empty via PUT (sentinel-None pattern).
paca_sales listing query uses created_at as ISO string with $gte – works because ISO-8601 is lexicographically sortable, but relying on string timestamps is fragile; prefer datetime objects.
seed_data_creation: Created and later deleted TEST_Paca_Maquillaje (price 250, commission 55) and TEST_Paca_Delete. A real paca sale was made to J2934 as part of flow test — this persists purchase/wallet entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pacas module is working. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_pacas_module.py can be used for regression. Note: test_create_paca_sale_success creates a real purchase in db for J2934 each run – consider cleanup if sale pollution matters later.
